record.samba_source: Kersale et al. (2020), doi:10.1126/sciadv.aba7573, stored in data/external
record.full_record_note: The repository holds only the Sep 2013 to Jul 2017 record. The NOAA FTP location and the HTTPS mirror were not reachable in this session, so the 2009 to 2013 part was not obtained.

conventions.sign: SAMBA upper cell northward positive; abyssal cell and NADW return layer southward positive (reanalysis series given the same sign)
conventions.anomaly: least squares on constant, linear trend, annual and semi-annual harmonics over the window
conventions.std: residual standard deviation with n - k degrees of freedom
conventions.std_ratio_ci: approximate, F interval with the effective degrees of freedom of each anomaly series
conventions.correlation_test: paper3r1_stats.corr_test with detrend=False on the anomalies (Bretherton et al. 1999 n_eff); design-matched check reported

daily_check.note: The daily file is the same 2013-2017 record; the monthly file is its monthly mean.
